_comment: USD per 1M tokens, matched by substring of the model id (first match wins). Source: https://claude.com/pricing (fetched 2026-10-09), 5-minute cache write; 1-hour cache write is not listed on that page. Haiku 5.5 is tiered by prompt size: the <=100K row is used (over 100K it is input 0.50, cache_write 0.625, cache_read 0.05, output 2.50). Only models used in this project are filled.
